string.name: module_desc
string.value: OBS Studio frontend for HarmonyOS PC

string.name: EntryAbility_desc
string.value: OBS Studio main window: scene mixing, streaming and recording

string.name: reason_microphone
string.value: OBS captures microphone audio as a source for your stream or recording.

string.name: reason_camera
string.value: OBS captures your camera as a video source for your stream or recording.

string.name: reason_background
string.value: Keeps an active broadcast running while the OBS window is minimized or in the background.

string.name: reason_screen_capture
string.value: OBS captures the display or a window as a video source for your stream or recording.

string.name: reason_screen_recording
string.value: Avoids the repeated system privacy prompt during long recording sessions. Requires AGC approval; OBS works without it.

string.name: reason_input_monitoring
string.value: Enables global hotkeys (start/stop streaming, push-to-talk) while OBS is not focused. Requires AGC review; OBS works without it.
